request.stage: head warmup; frozen Dense6 native DiT
request.architecture: SiLU -> causal3x1x1 3072->3072 -> five (ConvTranspose1x2x2 + causal3x3x3 + SiLU) -> causal3x1x1 scalar
request.temporal_adaptation: Native token0 maps frame0; token1..20 each maps4raw frames, with learned phase embedding before causal detailer
request.input: Existing BF16 last-layer features after native fixed-t=0 head normalization/modulation; not raw pre-head s+e_t
differences_from_paper: Native RGB VAE encoder and latent AR history retained
Temporal expansion for native compressed tokens
Scalar depth instead of RGB; LPIPS on replicated depth
Deterministic t=0 MSE, no flow/noise reweighting
Five levels for spatial patch32; widths adapted to D3072
request.loss: pixel MSE +0.2 temporal Charbonnier(delta=0.001) +0.2 VGG LPIPS on4frames
request.optimizer: AdamW lr1e-4 beta0.9/0.95 wd0 clip1 EMA0.999; constant LR as paper
request.sampling: 4 GPUs x2 crops/update; each crop8targetframes plus up to14contextframes,256x256->192x192 core; four-case CPU bank, refresh1 per2steps perGPU; disjoint exhaustive rank partitions
request.precision: BF16 conv autocast, FP32 final scalar output/loss/master weights
request.evaluation: 16 validation clips every2000; full445 validation/full471 test at fixed final step, no test checkpoint selection
